description: Client-side script for 'Payment Order' form in ERPNext, handling form setup, button actions, and data mapping for payment processing.

classes.name: frappe.ui.Dialog
classes.description: UI dialog component used for input collection in payment records creation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes form query filters and properties.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Handles form refresh actions, including adding buttons based on document status.

methods.name: remove_row_if_empty
methods.description: Removes references row if the first row is empty.

methods.name: remove_button
methods.description: Removes specific custom buttons based on payment order type.

methods.name: get_from_payment_entry
methods.description: Maps data from Payment Entry to Payment Order.

methods.name: get_from_payment_request
methods.description: Maps data from Payment Request to Payment Order.

methods.name: make_payment_records
methods.description: Creates a dialog for selecting supplier and mode of payment, then triggers creation of payment records.
